$comment: Reconciliation manifest for the local CI gate. Read by scripts/check-ci-drift.mjs.
One entry per step in .github/workflows, keyed by '<workflow>::<job>::<step name>'.
hash   - content hash of the step (run/uses + with + env + if) when it was last
reconciled. The guard recomputes it; a mismatch fails the gate.
mirror - the local command asserted to cover this step, or null when exempt.
reason - why the mirror covers it, or why it cannot run locally. Required.
IMPORTANT: `mirror` is a HUMAN ASSERTION, not something the guard verifies. The
guard's job is to make sure that assertion is re-made whenever the CI step changes,
so the local gate cannot drift out of sync in silence. When a hash mismatch sends
you here, actually re-read the workflow step before bumping the hash.

front-2-ci.yml::supply-chain::Smoke star.reason: ci-front-2 runs pnpm --filter front-2 smoke:start. The workflow does this with inline bash (background job + trap + curl + grep) which cannot run under the justfile's pwsh shell on Windows, so apps/front-2/scripts/smoke-start-server.mjs re-implements the same assertions in Node: serve the production build, GET /, require a rel=stylesheet link to a .css asset. DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE: CI hardcodes port 3000 (a fresh runner has nothing else on it); the local script binds a free ephemeral port via PORT, because probing a busy 3000 on a dev machine would assert against whatever unrelated app answered and report a false green.

front-2-ci.yml::supply-chain::Lint front.reason: ci-lint runs the same three commands with the same oxlint scope. It deliberately does not reuse `just lint` (oxlint over the whole repo): that superset is red on develop over pre-existing errors in the unlinted apps/front-2-spike app, so it would fail the gate on things CI passes.

front-2-e2e.yml::front-2-e2e::Wait for f.reason: ci-e2e-front-2 uses 'docker compose up --wait --wait-timeout 180' instead of the workflow's hand-rolled docker inspect polling loop. Same property (every service running and healthy before Playwright starts, 180s budget), enforced by compose itself rather than by bash.

front-2-e2e.yml::front-2-e2e::Run playwr.reason: ci-e2e-front-2 runs the same playwright install + playwright test. DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE: it drops --with-deps, which shells out to sudo apt-get and fails on any machine without passwordless sudo. A pre-push gate must not require root. The browser binary still installs to the user cache; system libraries are a one-time developer setup (npx playwright install-deps).

front-2-e2e.yml::front-2-e2e::Upload pla.reason: actions/upload-artifact exists to get files off an ephemeral runner. Locally the report is already on disk at apps/front-2/playwright-report; there is nothing to upload it to.

front-2-e2e.yml::front-2-e2e::Tear down.reason: ci-e2e-front-2 runs the identical docker compose ... down -v as its final step. DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE: this workflow step is if:always(), which a justfile cannot express (just stops at the first failing line), so the recipe also resets the stack with down -v --remove-orphans before bringing it up. Net effect is the same clean slate per run; a failed run's stack is left up locally for inspection instead.

require-linked-issue.yml::require-linked.reason: Reads github.event.pull_request.body. At pre-push time there is no PR and therefore no body to check, so this gate is unreproducible locally by construction rather than by omission. It stays a required GitHub check.
